title.en: Ebola’s next vaccines face the evidence test
title.zh: 埃博拉候选疫苗走向证据考验

summary.en: WHO’s November4 trial recommendation meets ECDC’s November5 outbreak update. New vaccine candidates still need national approvals and efficacy evidence against Bundibugyo; dated case totals and species-specific approvals matter.
summary.zh: WHO十一月四日的试验建议，与ECDC十一月五日的疫情更新交汇。新候选疫苗仍待国家批准及针对本迪布焦病毒的有效性证据；病例截止日期与病毒种别的审批边界尤其重要。

title.en: A drone rehearses a lander’s last-minute decision
title.zh: 无人机演练着陆前的最后抉择

summary.en: NASA’s November4 report describes an August27 drone test of SPLICE navigation and hazard avoidance. A ground demonstration opens useful possibilities for precise landings; the test environment and unresolved timeline details remain explicit.
summary.zh: NASA十一月四日报道，SPLICE导航与避险系统于八月二十七日完成无人机演示。地面测试为精确着陆带来可验证的可能，测试环境及资料中的时间差异仍需明确。
